title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 3: Solomon begins to build Yahweh's house on Mount Moriah, with the most holy place, the cherubim and the two pillars.

questions.text: On which mountain did Solomon begin to build Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:1 says Solomon began to build Yahweh's house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah.

questions.text: On whose threshing floor was the place that David had appointed?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:1 says it was on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

questions.text: In which year of his reign did Solomon begin to build?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:2 says he began to build on the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

questions.text: From where was the gold that Solomon used in the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:6 says the gold was gold from Parvaim.

questions.text: How much fine gold was used to overlay the most holy place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:8 says he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

questions.text: What was the weight of the nails?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:9 says the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold.

questions.text: Which way were the faces of the two cherubim turned?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:13 says the cherubim stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

questions.text: With what was the veil ornamented?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:14 says Solomon made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

questions.text: How high were the two pillars Solomon made before the house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:15 says the two pillars were thirty-five cubits high, with a capital of five cubits on top of each.

questions.text: What name was given to the pillar on the right hand?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 3:17 says the pillar on the right hand was called Jachin, and the one on the left Boaz.
